definitions.explanation: Physical pain as a medical symptom. The clinical word used by doctors, in medical records, and on drug labels.

examples.japanese: {疼痛|とうつう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}く→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧。
⟦{術後|じゅつご}→術後：15639_jutsugo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{疼痛|とうつう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{抑|おさ}える→抑える：12806_osaeru⟧。

⟦{慢性|まんせい}→慢性：09014_mansei⟧{疼痛|とうつう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{悩|なや}む→悩む：02380_nayamu⟧⟦{患者|かんじゃ}→患者：00170_kanja⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{専門|せんもん}→専門：01251_senmon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{外来|がいらい}→外来：09895_gairai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{設|もう}けられた→設ける：14220_moukeru⟧。
examples.english: A specialist outpatient clinic was set up for patients suffering from chronic pain.

notes:
USAGE:
A medical term. In conversation, people say ⟦{痛|いた}み→痛み：01795_itami⟧, or describe the body part (⟦{頭|あたま}→頭：00574_atama⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{痛|いた}い→痛い：01108_itai⟧).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{慢性|まんせい}→慢性：09014_mansei⟧{疼痛|とうつう}: chronic pain
- {疼痛|とうつう}⟦{緩和|かんわ}→緩和：13846_kanwa⟧: pain relief
- {疼痛|とうつう}⟦{管理|かんり}→管理：00178_kanri⟧: pain management

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{痛|いた}み→痛み：01795_itami⟧: the everyday word for pain
- ⟦{苦痛|くつう}→苦痛：02652_kutsuu⟧: suffering, physical or mental
